description: Generate starship names by class — frigates, cruisers, dreadnoughts, shuttles, and carriers, each with a fitting registry number.

faqs.a: Frigate, Cruiser, Dreadnought, Shuttle, and Carrier — each class gets names with the right tone, from swift to imposing.
Each name gets a registry like 'NCC-1701' style hull numbers for flavor.
8 names per click, all unique in the batch.
Click any name to copy it.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Click any name to copy it.
title: Spaceship Name Generator
